title: The many spellings of Veteris and Vitiris
description:
Interactive map of the votive dedications to the god (or gods) Veteris from Roman Britain, concentrated along Hadrian's Wall, compiled within the FRAG – Fractured Roots project (PRJ-2171, Università degli Studi di Palermo). The map compares the graphemic variants of the theonym, allows filtering by variant, initial letter and number (singular / plural), and displays the text of each inscription with its RIB reference. The file is a self-contained HTML page: download it and open it in any browser (an internet connection is needed for the base maps).
